text: 英国央行金融政策委员会：包括部分私募信贷在内的高风险信贷市场，仍易受融资条件收紧影响。 英国家庭和企业仍具韧性，银行体系资本充足。 逆周期资本缓冲维持在2%。
text_en: Bank of England Financial Policy Committee: High-risk credit markets, including some private credit, remain vulnerable to tighter financing conditions. UK households and businesses remain resilient, and the banking system is adequately capitalized. The countercyclical capital buffer remains at 2%.
